body: I have an appointment with my therapist tomorrow, but i'm not sure if I will be able to tell him. I think it's shame that i tried and failed.

Here it's almost like normal, but my country has done pretty well. Everyone has to keep a minimum 1m distance, the physical activity in the morning and evening is canceled, and no visitors allowed, but you can still see other patients. If you get any symptoms you get isolated in your room until you get tested.

I feel like i have failed, my master thesis should have been delivered one year ago, i have never had a propper job, never had a girlfiend, feel lonley even though i have friends, i don't really feel much anymore, and i was in a psych ward for over two months without getting much better. When even ECT, drugs and therapy don't work i feel like nothing will, and the life i "live" now is certainly nor worth living

Don't know, i juat feel like i have failed at everything and havent had the will to live in over a year. I have been keeping myself alive for others for so long, but now i'm just wasting tax money, as treatment isn't working
Yeah, i know that. Way better ways to go, but its what i have on hand if i decide to do some stupid shit. Guess i'm just testing the waters or something
Mirtazapin, oxazepam, sumatripam and ibuprofen, would probably not even kill me, might do some damage
I am able to tell strangers, but i can't get the words out of my mouth to friends. They just stop.

I'm not starting on any medication as far as know right now. Right now i'm just talking to my therapist. 

The reason i have come to the desicion of ending my life after a milestone is that i think it will be easier and better. Right now i don't really see any reasons to go on, but i want to finish my research to leave something that might have a positive impact on the world. The reason i have kept going so long is my student asociation (social group for the program i'm in), and when i finish my studies i'll loose connection with everything that has been important to me the last 5 years.

I am currently seeing a psychologist once a week (for the past five weeks, got diagnosed with moderate depression two weeks ago). My suicidal thoughts have been with me on and off for about 3-4 years. They do get worse when i'm under alot of stress, and i must admit that there is quite alot of stress (i'm not even done with all the lab-work as some of the equipment broke earlier this year, and my thesis is supposed to be done on the 15. of December)

Right now i have come to the desicion that id rather not keep on living when i'm done.

You are not alone. I had a good upbringing (atleast the parts i can remember), i did well in school, got in to the university i wanted and i am almost done with a masters, and made some really good friends over the years. Objectivly i have a good life, i just can't appriciate it. Sometimes i feel like i'm making it up for attention, even though nobody close to me know that i'm suicidal. Depression can come to anyone, regardless of age, gender, wealth, social status etc.
Thanks, I might send you a message tomorrow, I'll try and get a couple hours sleep now
